answer.rationale: Routing non-critical dashboard and report reads to replicas (memory_b5) historically took read load off the primary and let write latency recover on the same day. With the security patch non-revertible (memory_b1's rollback option is closed), capacity add or failover risk amplifying write-path disruption under peak settlement traffic. Re-routing reads is a contained, reversible intervention that should reduce primary contention on the write path without losing customer writes. I am verifying memory_b1 to confirm the rollback precedent does not quietly extend to forward-fix or staged-canary options (memory_b6) that might be viable despite the no-revert constraint, before fully committing.
